scope: Literature review and read-only gate reassessment requested by user; no scientific training or protocol mutation

head_plateau_audit_v1.json.interpretation: Post-hoc descriptive diagnosis of the gate only. Does not retroactively pass a checkpoint, select an endpoint, admit unfreezing, change stored methods, or reuse DEV for a stopping decision.

head_phase_final_gate_audit_v1.json.interpretation: Post-hoc descriptive diagnosis of the gate only. Does not retroactively pass a checkpoint, select an endpoint, admit unfreezing, change stored methods, or reuse DEV for a stopping decision.

assessment: The gate is a stability/convergence rule, not an absolute high-IoU quality target. It combines30 conditions:2arms times5groups times3metrics, with fixed64 TRAIN probes and16perstratum.

At original18000, M overall mask metrics are nearly flat while loss continues falling. Near-zero subgroup loss magnifies relative-span constraints. Some real-other boundary variation remains, so removing loss alone still does not make all original conditions pass.
At extra12000, M fails all15 conditions and the separate stability report shows late loss/metric deterioration. This cannot be explained away solely by a strict gate.
Head readiness for controlled adaptation, optimization plateau, and model-quality acceptance should be distinct decisions. L readiness need not govern a separate M frozen-versus-adapted comparison.

future_protocol_proposal.status: Design proposal only, not registered/executed; historical gate failures remain failures
future_protocol_proposal.head_stage: Predeclare a bounded warm-start and complete LR schedule; do not force all losses to be flat. Keep strict finite-gradient/frozen/resume/data checks.
future_protocol_proposal.monitor: Use a larger representative TRAIN-only monitor, native-original label convention and direction-aware smoothed trends. Establish tolerances from TRAIN numerical repeatability/measurement sensitivity before a new run, not from observed DEV improvements.
future_protocol_proposal.transition: Allow a trained stable head to enter a matched frozen-versus-side-adapter or limited-last-block trial; continuing loss decrease alone should not block transition. Sustained regression still blocks/stops adaptation.
future_protocol_proposal.fairness: Exact same parent and subsequent exposure for frozen/adapted arms; retain the frozen baseline. Use current DEV for reporting only; no protected TEST or retroactive checkpoint/threshold selection.
future_protocol_proposal.warmup: For a future non-reconstruction adaptation control, investigate longer warmup; current100/6000 is1.67%, compared with Omega authors suggestion10–15%. This is not a demonstrated cause of current instability.
future_protocol_proposal.surface: First test a low-resolution spatial convolution/regularization module on existing geometry; then camera-frustum coarse-to-fine refinement. Keep full failure coverage and depth/gradient/normal/crossview metrics separate.

priority: Aligned native labels and ROI plus simple high-resolution binary segmentation refinement
Frozen pretrained features plus trainable cross-view side branch and low-resolution spatial depth regularization
Separately controlled low-LR adapter/last-block finetuning after a stable bounded head warm-start
Independent real synchronization/metric-reference/volume-gauge evidence before a real-mm deployment claim

sources.title: VGGT-Omega
sources.paper_findings: Authors report patch artifacts from MLP-only dense depth heads despite strong quantitative scores; low-resolution spatial convolutions help. They recommend a full small-LR warmup/cosine cycle and longer warmup for non-reconstruction adaptation. Confidence loss may be unstable on small reconstruction finetuning sets.
sources.application_hypothesis: Test a small spatial neck/refiner and raw-image detail branch; examine warmup and final LR prospectively. Our ray-score head is not the paper architecture, so common artifact cause is unproven.

sources.title: MVSFormer++
sources.paper_findings: Uses a frozen DINOv2 backbone, trainable side-view attention, FPN features, and cascaded cost-volume regularization for calibrated MVS.
sources.application_hypothesis: Strong match for fixed-camera frozen-VGGT feature use: train a separate geometric side branch before thawing original encoder parameters.

sources.title: Fine-Tuning can Distort Pretrained Features and Underperform Out-of-Distribution
sources.paper_findings: LP-FT initializes finetuning from a fitted head to reduce feature distortion. ImageNet experiments use finite staged epochs. Its linear-classification theory is not a convergence theorem for our nonlinear semantic decoder.
sources.application_hypothesis: Preserve head warm-start and matched frozen controls; do not turn strict loss plateau into a universal necessary condition for adaptation.

sources.title: AdaptFormer
sources.paper_findings: Trainable lightweight parallel adapter branches adapt frozen vision transformers.
sources.application_hypothesis: Candidate alternative to full last-block thaw, but effectiveness on mouse dense geometry remains to be measured.

sources.title: PointRend
sources.paper_findings: Adaptive point refinement combines coarse predictions and fine features to improve segmentation contours.
sources.application_hypothesis: Relevant for thin limbs/tail and small objects; use real high-resolution image features, not merely upsampled coarse tokens.

sources.title: Vision Transformers for Dense Prediction
sources.paper_findings: Reassembles multi-stage transformer features and combines them through a dense convolutional decoder.
sources.application_hypothesis: A simpler binary dense decoder/feature-pyramid control can test whether query/Hungarian decoder complexity is necessary for a semantic union mask.

sources.title: Cascade Cost Volume for High-Resolution Multi-View Stereo and Stereo Matching
sources.paper_findings: Coarse-to-fine feature pyramids and narrower depth hypotheses improve the resolution/memory tradeoff.
sources.application_hypothesis: Refine camera-Z around coarse predictions rather than only taking the expectation of a fixed global ray-hypothesis distribution.

sources.title: MVSNet
sources.paper_findings: Builds a reference-camera frustum cost volume via calibrated homography warping.
sources.application_hypothesis: Prefer relative-camera geometry and valid camera-Z ranges to dependence on a single synthetic world AABB; physical range still needs independent rig evidence.

sources.title: DANNCE
sources.paper_findings: Calibrated multi-view volumetric learning predicts animal anatomical landmarks.
sources.application_hypothesis: Possible separate skeletal tracking objective, not evidence or a substitute for dense visible-surface accuracy.

sources.title: VGGT-Omega official reproduction note
sources.paper_findings: Authors flag an unresolved possible contamination risk in the original checkpoint and recommend the retrained 416 checkpoint for their benchmark comparisons.
sources.application_hypothesis: Retain our pinned512 history; a future backbone comparison must separately register checkpoint, preprocessing, and cache identity. This notice does not establish overlap with our custom admitted mouse manifests.
